status: experimental coordination architecture; reuses existing deny-dominant policy algebra
purpose: Make cross-layer policy conflicts and downgrade attempts explicit when combining kernel, owner, Circle, institution, jurisdiction, adapter, action-risk, and fallback requirements.
core_invariants: existing kernel deny-dominant merge remains authoritative for currently implemented production constraints
higher-precedence or non-waivable floors cannot be weakened by lower layers
lower layers may narrow authority or strengthen assurance/privacy requirements
fallback candidates must independently satisfy the full composed policy
an unavailable preferred verifier/provider cannot cause silent routing to a weaker forbidden alternative
exceptions require explicit authority, scope, expiry, evidence, and review; exception presence is not itself success
conflict visibility is mandatory in human- and machine-readable outputs
policy conflict resolution never relies on actor prestige, institutional size, reputation score, or graph centrality
nonclaims: This profile does not replace mesh/src/lib/policy.mjs or alter current production policy semantics.
This profile does not define a universal jurisdictional supremacy rule.
This profile does not grant exceptions automatically.
This profile does not make every policy dimension linearly ordered.
